title: Use Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP and 10,000 bps divisor for financial calculations
trigger: When encountering AssertionError in financial/billing tests or implementing monetary calculations involving Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, and basis points (bps)
strategy: Always parse monetary inputs with decimal.Decimal, divide basis points (bps) by Decimal('10000') (10,000 bps == 100%), and quantize each intermediate calculation to Decimal('0.01') with rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP.
anti_pattern: Never use binary float, standard round() (which uses round-half-to-even), or divide basis points (bps) by 100 instead of 10,000.
